audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated the lane TRICKY 7/10 with Pantheon owning levels 1 through 4-5, while the packet levelChart, the content win[] column and a 54.73% win rate over 2390 games all say Katarina wins every stage. The page argued with itself on the headline verdict.
audit.why: Nothing in Pantheon's kit supports enemy-favoured early rows against Katarina: Comet Spear is 575 range and dodgeable behind minions, Shield Vault must land ON you from 600, and Aegis Assault is 22s at rank 1 and only blocks its facing direction.
audit.corrected: EVEN at 5/10 with Katarina on every chart row, and the difficulty text rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and breakdown.cooldowns named no Pantheon timing, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' Shield Vault cooldown.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s, not 15s. Aegis Assault is 22s at rank 1. Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1. Comet Spear is 11s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into cooldowns, spikes and the Do's bullet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction text said only 'point-and-click stun — respect the all-in'. Two decisive mechanics were missing: Aegis Assault is directional and is itself a channel, and Shield Vault carries an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's E text: he is invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT — so a Shunpo behind him is blocked by nothing. It also carries the channel flag, so it can be interrupted. And the W autoReset flag means his burst tell is the attack wind-up, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Shunpo behind him rather than onto him, and read the auto wind-up as the cue to step back.

audit.whatIsWrong: brief.missingInteractions key 20 claims Katarina's Bouncing Blade (Q) shuts off Shield Vault and Grand Starfall. It does not.
audit.why: The 'grounding' flag on Katarina's Q is a tooltip-parse misfire on the phrase 'ricocheting onto the ground'. Riot's Q description contains no grounding effect. The second half of that key — the Shield Vault auto-reset tell — is real and was used.
audit.corrected: Grounding claim not written. Auto-reset tell written into dosFull[1].

notes: Two things the user should see. (1) This matchup's full layer was rated TRICKY 7/10 with Pantheon holding levels 1 through 4-5, while the packet levelChart, the content win[] column and the 54.73% win rate over 2390 games all put Katarina on every row. I moved the chart, the diff/diffRating/carryRating/tone group and both difficulty strings onto the Katarina-favoured reading. If the user disagrees with the rating move, the chart rows alone are still unambiguous and should stand. No win[N] edits were possible — the content layer already read Katarina on all seven rows. (2) brief.missingInteractions key 20's first headline — Bouncing Blade grounding Shield Vault and Grand Starfall — is FALSE and must not be applied for any Katarina matchup. Katarina's Q carries a spurious 'grounding' derived flag from the tooltip phrase 'ricocheting onto the ground'; Riot's description has no grounding. The second headline in that key, the Shield Vault auto-reset tell, is genuine and was written into dosFull[1].
